summary: Phase 2 testing complete: 5 new Resource Center articles (Managed IT Pricing, MSP vs Break-Fix, Internal IT vs MSP, Co-Managed vs Fully Managed, Copilot vs ChatGPT) verified end-to-end on backend and frontend. Site-wide BlogRelatedResources 'blog-related-service' link change (from '/#core-services' to dedicated /services/:slug pages) verified on both new posts and 3 existing posts across Cybersecurity, Compliance, and Financial Services categories - all navigate correctly to fully-rendered service pages with 200 status. Backend API (/api/blog, /api/blog/:slug) returns correct data for all 5 new slugs, no duplicate slugs, 404 handled correctly for invalid slugs. sitemap.xml valid XML, includes all 5 new URLs, no duplicate <loc> entries, no broken existing entries. Article JSON-LD schema parses correctly on all tested pages (12 JSON-LD blocks incl. Article type, no parse errors). Regression spot-check: homepage (all 8 sections present), /human-risk-simulation, and /services/managed-it-services all render correctly and unaffected by Phase 2 changes.

issues: No search bar or category filter UI exists on the Resources index page (BlogIndex.jsx) - it is a static grid of all 147 articles with no filtering mechanism. This is a PRE-EXISTING gap not introduced by Phase 2, but the review request explicitly asked to verify 'search/filter by category Managed IT should show 4 of them' which cannot be validated because the feature does not exist in the UI.

action_items: Optional/clarify: Resources index page (/resources) has no search/category filter UI - if this was assumed to exist for Phase 2 discoverability requirement, it needs to be built; otherwise no action needed since it's out of Phase 2's stated scope (files_of_reference didn't include BlogIndex.jsx).
No blocking bugs found - all 5 new articles, backend APIs, sitemap, and the site-wide related-service link change are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: contentLinks.js categoryServiceMap and getBlogRelatedLinks() correctly implement fallback to managed-it-services for unmapped categories - clean and defensive.
BlogRelatedResources.jsx cleanly uses new serviceSlug/serviceName instead of hardcoded anchor - no regressions observed across 8 tested posts (5 new + 3 existing categories).
blog_data.py ALL_BLOG_POSTS correctly dedupes by slug (BLOG_POSTS_EXTENDED filtered against BLOG_POSTS slugs) preventing duplicate entries - verified via API, 147 total posts, zero duplicate slugs.
New blog post content correctly follows FAQ format described (bolded question + answer inline per paragraph) - renders correctly in UI with proper bold formatting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified, 1 pre-existing minor gap noted - not a Phase 2 regression)

test_credentials: None required - public marketing site, no auth on tested routes.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing blog data, no test data created or needed cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 (5 new Resource Center articles + site-wide BlogRelatedResources service-link change) is fully verified and passing. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_blog_resources.py can be reused as regression suite for future blog-related changes. Only open item is the /resources index page lacking search/filter UI (pre-existing, out of Phase 2 scope per files_of_reference) - flag to main agent only if a future phase explicitly requires building that feature.
